# Futora Group — Complete Entity Reference

## Executive Summary
Futora Group is an AI-first product and services technology company founded by Madhur Dhadve. The company operates on a dual business model:
1. Product Ecosystem: Designing, engineering, and launching proprietary AI-driven software platforms across financial technology, social networks, artificial intelligence infrastructure, and workflow operating systems.
2. Growth & Technology Services: Delivering enterprise AI integration, high-performance web and cloud architecture, and growth marketing systems for high-growth startups and established brands.

Futora Group of Companies is a Government of India recognized MSME.

## Core Products & Subsidiaries

### 1. FutoraOne
- Type: Social Media & Tech Community Platform
- URL: https://futora1.vercel.app/
- Description: FutoraOne is an AI-powered social media and tech community platform where developers, creators, and founders connect, share projects, and collaborate.

### 2. Futora Finance (FutoraPay & Futora Wallet)
- Type: Fintech & Financial Operating System
- URL: https://futorapay.vercel.app/ & https://futorawallet.vercel.app/
- Description: Futora Finance is a next-generation AI financial infrastructure providing intelligent wallet management, real-time UPI transaction pipelines, and autonomous personal finance tooling.

### 3. Futora AI
- Type: Core AI Research & Tools Brand
- URL: https://futoraai.vercel.app/
- Description: Futora AI develops autonomous agent frameworks, intelligent developer tools, and cutting-edge artificial intelligence educational systems.

### 4. FutoraLift
- Type: Performance Marketing & AI Growth Engine
- URL: https://futoralift.vercel.app/
- Description: FutoraLift is an AI-powered growth and marketing agency that automates ad optimization, data analytics, and user acquisition pipelines.

### 5. FutoraFlow
- Type: AI Business Operating System
- URL: https://futoraflow.vercel.app/
- Description: FutoraFlow is a unified execution brain that orchestrates tasks, automates business workflows, and provides centralized business intelligence.

### 6. Career OS
- Type: Proof-of-Work Career & Talent Platform
- URL: https://careerosx.vercel.app/
- Description: Career OS is a proof-of-work hiring and learning platform connecting ambitious builders with verified internships and startup roles.

## Growth Services (Client Offerings)
- AI Consulting & Strategy: Helping companies evaluate, design, and adopt artificial intelligence and automated systems.
- Custom AI & Software Engineering: Full-stack product architecture, microservices, and AI-native application development.
- Performance Marketing & User Acquisition: Data-driven user growth, funnel optimization, and automated conversion campaigns.
- Cloud & Infrastructure Optimization: Scalable cloud deployments, security hardening, and database architecture.
